_about: Every date on Home's 'Tools over time' chart. Edit here, then run python3 scripts/build_tool_timeline.py (CI runs it with --check). Dates are YYYY-MM, or YYYY when only the year is known (a year-only start means January, a year-only end means December). "to": null means still in use. "through" is the month the chart's 'Now' line stands for: move it forward when you rebuild.
